question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Generosity
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Generosity"** means the quality of being kind and generous; willingness to give more help or money than is usual or expected. (उदारता)

 
 
• **Example: **Her **generosity** towards the homeless is truly inspiring.
 
 
 
• **"Selfishness" **refers to the quality or state of being selfish; lacking consideration for others and being chiefly concerned with one's own personal profit or pleasure. (स्वार्थ)
 
 
• **Example: **His **selfishness **was evident when he refused to share his food with the hungry children.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Generosity' **is **'Selfishness'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Strength **(शक्ति): The quality or state of being physically strong.

 
 
• **Example:** Her **strength** was evident when she lifted the heavy box effortlessly.
 
 
 
• **Selflessness **(निःस्वार्थता ): Concern more with the needs and wishes of others than with one's own; unselfish.
 
 
• **Example: **Her **selflessness** was evident when she donated her entire paycheck to charity.
 
 
 
• **Activeness** (सक्रियता): The quality of being active; the state of being engaged in action.
 
 
• **Example:** His **activeness** in community service is highly commendable.
